meta.title: Code toolkit
meta.description: Five commands that work with no arguments. Review looks at the uncommitted changes (or the branch against its base when the tree is clean), reports, and fixes what it finds — add report for the report only. Simplify and scrub cover the whole project and write by default (add report for a plan only). Caption runs a hard task through an explicit loop with a ledger, and can create expert subagents mid-run for work that splits without colliding. Pua installs a protocol for changing method and showing evidence instead of shrugging. Add sub to run in an isolated agent instead. Prompts are organised as a layered skill-style tree, with a deterministic test suite and a model evaluation loop.
